issue.title: Move Patch query bar to the pane-top layout slot
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Move `PatchFilterBar` from the top of the Patch detail column to the shared
pane-top query-bar slot that every other FILTER_SESSION Artifacts pane now
uses.

Today `ArtifactsPatchesPane` is a `Horizontal`, so the always-on query bar
lives in the detail column. That is the single documented exception in
`docs/artifacts_pane_visual_grammar.md` (Patch's contract-in/spec-out
asymmetry). Relocating it makes the layout order uniform: query bar, then
identity/scope, then content.

The change will shift PNG goldens across otherwise-unrelated suites (Agents,
AXE, Config Center all screenshot the default Patch view). Update those
goldens with scoped `just test-visual -- <node> --sase-update-visual-snapshots`
only; never `just test-visual-update` (sase-lo).

PROPOSED BY: phase bead sase-qy.4 (epic sase-qy, Always-on query bar across
every Artifacts sub-tab). The epic plan named this as explicit follow-up so
the remaining layout inconsistency is tracked rather than forgotten.
